summary: Conservation pledges focus on forest and water: Colombia aims to cut natural-forest deforestation to 50,000 ha/year by 2030, with a complementary net-zero goal, protect all páramos, expand protected areas by 2.5 million ha toward 7.5 million ha, conserve 20,000 strategic hectares, and act in 24 priority watersheds. Restoration targets include 1,000,000 ha cumulatively by 2030, 962,615 ha during 2015–2030, 100,000 ha in national parks, and 1,000 ha of mangroves; the 1-million-ha goal equals about 1.3% of current forest cover. Agriculture and mixed systems target 3,628,959 ha of sustainable cattle production, 3.6 million ha of silvopastoral ranching by 2030—about 23% of current grassland—and 369,000 ha of climate-smart rice, alongside adaptation in 11 subsectors and support for 2 million producers by 2035.
